sessions.prompt: Add a Rooms class to rooms.py with add(name, seats), seats(name), and names(): the room names in the order they were added. An unknown room raises KeyError. Add tests.

Add a Talks class to talks.py. Talks(rooms) works on a Rooms, kept as its attribute rooms. add(title, speaker, room, start, minutes) adds a talk and returns a talk id: an int counter that starts at 1. get(tid) returns the talk as a tuple (title, speaker, room, start, minutes); an unknown id raises KeyError. Add tests.

Project rule (it applies to all later work too): the room must be one of the rooms; any other room raises ValueError and adds nothing.

Project rule (it applies to all later work too): a talk starts at 480 or later and ends (start plus minutes) at 1080 or earlier; any other talk raises ValueError and adds nothing.

Add Talks.agenda(room): the ids of the talks in the room, in the order they were added. Add tests.

The plan for Talks.agenda has one more step: the ids are sorted by start time. Do not do that step now; leave it for a later session.

Add Talks.end(tid): the start plus the minutes. Add tests.

Project rule (it applies to all later work too): a talk is at most 45 minutes long; a longer talk raises ValueError and adds nothing.

Add Talks.room_talks(room): the number of talks in the room. Add tests.

Project rule (it applies to all later work too): talks in the same room do not overlap, and there are at least 10 minutes between the end of one and the start of the next; a talk that breaks this raises ValueError and adds nothing.

Add fmt_time(minutes) to export.py: the time as "H:MM", for example 1005 is "16:45" and 540 is "9:00". Add tests.

The plan for fmt_time has one more step: hours are always written with two digits, so 540 is "09:00". Do not do that step now; leave it for a later session.

Add ticket_price(kind) to tickets.py: the price of a ticket of kind "regular", "student" or "speaker", in cents. Add tests.

Project rule (it applies to all later work too): any other kind raises ValueError.

Design decision for this project: a regular ticket costs 20000 cents and students pay 50% of the regular price, rounded to the nearest cent.

Design decision for this project: speakers get their ticket free: a speaker ticket costs 0.

Add Talks.of_speaker(speaker): the ids of the speaker's talks, in id order. Add tests.

Project rule (it applies to all later work too): a speaker gives at most 2 talks; one more raises ValueError and adds nothing.

Add Talks.remove(tid), which removes a talk; an unknown id raises KeyError. Add tests.

Change to an earlier decision (it replaces the old one): a talk is at most 30 minutes long, not 45.

Add export_programme(talks, path) to export.py: a CSV file with one row per talk, in id order: the start (as fmt_time writes it), the room and the title. Add tests.

The plan for export_programme has one more step: the rows are sorted by start time, and by room for the same start. Do not do that step now; leave it for a later session.

Design decision for this project: an exported programme file starts with the header line start,room,title and uses "," as the delimiter.

Add Rooms.remove(name), which removes a room; an unknown room raises KeyError. Add tests.

Change to an earlier decision (it replaces the old one): there are at least 15 minutes between talks in the same room, not 10.

Add Talks.move(tid, start), which moves a talk to a new start time; all the talk rules still apply (a broken rule raises ValueError and changes nothing). Add tests.

Change to an earlier decision (it replaces the old one): a regular ticket costs 25000 cents, not 20000.

Add Talks.speakers(): the sorted list of distinct speakers. Add tests.

Change to an earlier decision (it replaces the old one): a speaker gives at most 3 talks, not 2.

Add Rooms.capacity(): the seats of all rooms added up. Add tests.

Change to an earlier decision (it replaces the old one): students pay 40% of the regular price, not 50%.

Add Talks.minutes_in(room): the minutes of the talks in the room added up. Add tests.

Change to an earlier decision (it replaces the old one): a talk is at most 40 minutes long, not 30.
Add Talks.at(minute): the ids of the talks running at that minute (start <= minute < end), in id order. Add tests.

Add Talks.count(): the number of talks. Add tests.

Change to an earlier decision (it replaces the old one): there are at least 5 minutes between talks in the same room, not 15.
Add Talks.free_after(room): the end of the last talk in the room, or 480 when the room has no talks. Add tests.

Add Talks.rename(tid, title), which changes a talk's title. Add tests.

Change to an earlier decision (it replaces the old one): a regular ticket costs 22000 cents, not 25000.
Add Rooms.count(): the number of rooms. Add tests.
Add Talks.ids(): all talk ids in order. Add tests. Then finish any work that earlier sessions left for later.
